outer_batch_active.meaning: a top-level multicall batch is executing and its outer loop has not finished
outer_batch_active.checkpoint: before the subsequent outer payload is processed

inner_payload_calls_multicall.meaning: a payload within the batch calls multicall again (nested multicall)
inner_payload_calls_multicall.checkpoint: during the outer batch, before the subsequent outer payload

inner_spends_eth_nonzero_msgvalue.meaning: the inner oracle update spends ETH with non-zero msgValue

followup_zero_value_call.meaning: a subsequent outer payload is a zero-value call
followup_zero_value_call.checkpoint: after the inner multicall returns, still inside the outer batch

batch_completes_without_incorrect_paymen.meaning: the top-level batch completes without reverting with E_IncorrectPayment
batch_completes_without_incorrect_paymen.checkpoint: at completion of the top-level multicall batch

assumptions: The batch is solvent; the report states solvency as a condition rather than an observed prior state.
The caller is an integrator composing helper contracts; the report does not state an authorization requirement for this flow.
Exact msgValue/msg.value numeric values are not given; the plan uses report-grounded Boolean observables for the non-zero-value inner spend and the zero-value follow-up call.

unresolved.description: Report does not give exact msgValue/msg.value amounts, so the non-zero inner spend and zero-value follow-up are represented as grounded Boolean observables rather than numeric comparisons.
Report states solvency as a condition ('even when solvent') but does not define the solvency observable or its threshold.

limitations: The plan formalizes only the liveness_dos_on_self impact; composability_break and user_facing_regression are not covered by this claim.
The E_IncorrectPayment revert is represented as the absence of successful batch completion, not as a numeric payment comparison, because the report gives no amounts.
The nested-multicall depth and the boolean _isMulticall reset are treated as the report-described scenario context, not as separate P facts beyond the selected precondition IDs.
